nodes.label: Credentials Page Side Illustration
nodes.description: SVG sidebar illustration for the credentials/authentication page. Features a warm peach/salmon background (#FCE8E2) with decorative brand-colored elements: a large arc/circle shape with gradient fill, a star/flame shape with gradient, a solid circle in a lighter pink tone, repeating rows of upward and downward pointing triangles in brand orange (#EE4723) at low opacity, wavy sinusoidal lines in brand orange at low opacity in the upper-right corner, and repeating chevron/arrow patterns in brand orange at low opacity in the upper-left corner. The overall aesthetic is abstract and decorative, conveying motion and energy through geometric patterns. Dimensions: 756x982px.
